svg.title: Where golden lion tamarins live
svg.desc: A simplified map of the coast of Rio de Janeiro State in Brazil. Golden lion tamarins live nowhere else on Earth, in scattered fragments of Atlantic Forest about 100 kilometres from the city of Rio de Janeiro. The BR-101 highway cuts through their range, and a forested bridge was built over it to reconnect two pieces. About 4,800 remain, up from fewer than 200 in the 1970s.

text.font-family: Georgia, serif
-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A scatter of forest north east of Rio de Janeiro. That is the whole world.
